Noah: Opening a live follow-up for today's all-hands focused on pipeline, GTM shifts, and partner asks. Keep threads short and actionable.

Priya: Partner ops note: to qualify for co-sell SDR hours partners must complete the joint-POV checklist and security attestation. I'll post checklist link later.
Maya: Product impact: the partner-facing dashboard (usage + cost breakdown) slips two weeks due to a dependency on private endpoints work.
Ethan: Forecast ops: we'll move partner-influenced deals into a separate forecast bucket. Finance asked that we label those opps with `partner-pilot` in SFDC.
Zoe: CS: we'll need an SLA template for pilot deals. baseline onboarding 30 days; partner-prioritized 10 business days. Is 10 realistic? @Priya
Priya: 10 business days for prioritized pilot is OK if partner commits SDR hours and provides a POA (plan of action) within 48h.
Ravi: Action: Sales to mark qualifying opps with tag `partner-pilot` by EOD Thu. RevOps will validate and notify finance.
Noah: Can someone drop the one-pager + checklist in this thread? Prefer short bullets and the approval path.
Priya: Will upload a 1-page checklist and approval flow by tomorrow AM.
